# mm

mm is a terminal queue for one person. You add an item, it shows you that item, you mark it done.

Nothing appears unless you type `mm add`. Tomorrow the item is gone unless you add it again. There is no config file, no daily seed, no habits, no calendar, and no web app for the queue itself.

## Install

```
git clone https://github.com/Toseef-Ahmad/mm.git
cd mm && ./install.sh
```

Requires Python 3.11+. No pip dependencies. State is one file: `~/.mm/state.json`.

## Containers

- queue — FIFO, `mm add "task"`
- interrupt stack — LIFO, `mm add -p "task"`, preempts the queue, then unwinds
- quick — batched, `mm add -q "task"`, never shown as next; clear with `mm flush-quick`

Bare `mm` is `mm next`.

## Not this

mm is not a planner. It does not inject work, track streaks, or sync notes.
